source_refs.note: Topic 6.2.2 (PDF 156-157, printed 153-154). Figure 6.1 shows one vendor's service categories rather than the three models; the original diagram shows the IaaS, PaaS and SaaS responsibility layers (general knowledge, flagged). Long question 3 is answered.

blocks.text: Cloud services fall into three main types, Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Software as a Service (SaaS), each offering a different level of control, flexibility and management.
